description: Human-authored storyboard flow contract used as an experimental bridge into SourceSceneIR. This file describes the authoring shape and validation rules; SourceSceneIR remains the production fact source after conversion.

catalogs.entities: Stable entity ids, human labels, kinds, optional visuals, and optional positions.
catalogs.resources: Stable resource ids, human labels, carrierEntity, and optional initial count.
catalogs.resourceCarrierRule: Each referenced resource should declare carrierEntity; the converter may materialize missing carriers but the authoring report warns about it.

preflightRules: Flow must be an object and include at least one phase.
Each phase must include title, guideText, requiredInteractions, completeCondition, and visibleEntities.
requiredInteractions verbs must be in interactionDsl.allowedVerbs.
Resource verbs must include a resource id.
Target verbs must include a target id.
click:* interactions are only allowed in the final CTA phase.
Merge or collision words in visualNotes are informational only and must not create combine steps unless requiredInteractions contains combine:*.
Referenced resources should exist in resources[] and declare carrierEntity.

authoringReport.resourceSnapshots: Per-phase entering/after resource counts derived only from requiredInteractions and resources[].initial.

downstreamPolicy: A flow export is not production-ready until storyboard-flow-authoring-report.json passes with zero blockers.
After conversion, source-ir-preflight.json must pass before SourceIR/Blueprint/WebGL/Luna handoff.
Visual parity, guideText parity, runtime contract, and CUA evidence remain downstream requirements.
